request: Analyze GSE242445 for PMID 38661340 (Deletion of FNDC5/irisin modifies murine osteocyte function in a sex-specific manner.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of long-bone osteocyte-enriched fractions, mouse, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (S4.16.p1, S11.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 3 per genotype x sex x diet cell; KO female control sample 23 excluded for Y-chromosome reads / low Xist (S4.15.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of FNDC5/irisin deletion (KO vs WT) and of sex on the osteocyte transcriptome, under control and low-calcium diet. No exercise intervention: exercise appears only as background on irisin as an exercise-induced myokine (ABS.p1, S1.p1, S1.p5).
planned_contrasts: WT F vs WT M (control diet) (S2.x, Supplementary file 3)
KO F vs WT F and KO M vs WT M (control diet) (Supplementary file 3)
KO lc vs WT lc within each sex (Supplementary file 4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper's transcriptomic estimands are genotype (FNDC5 KO vs WT), sex and low-calcium diet. Exercise is mentioned only as the stimulus that releases irisin in muscle (ABS.p1, S1.p1); no mouse in the study is exercised or kept sedentary as an experimental arm. Threshold: unadjusted p < 0.01 and |log2FC| > 1 (S4.16.p1).

checks: S11.p1 names GSE242445 as the osteocyte transcriptome deposit
23 samples = 24 sequenced minus excluded sample 23 (S4.15.p1); KO_F_C_23 is absent from the matrix
series contributor Shimonty / Bonewald Lab matches authors

ownership.reasoning: Paper data-availability statement names GSE242445; sample labels encode genotype/sex/diet exactly as in the paper's design.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (e.g. WT_F_C_1) sit inside the GEO title in brackets; exact match on that derived key for all 23. Factors parsed from the key. Note: GEO characteristics 'treatment' is constant ('2 weeks of low-calcium-diet') for all samples although titles distinguish control (C) and low-calcium (LC); title is used.

matrix.recommended_method: none (no raw integer counts deposited; DESeq2 would need rounding of normalized values)
matrix.reasoning: File is named AllnormalizedReadCounts; integer fraction 0.20, non-integer values; data_processing says DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization. It is size-factor-normalized counts, not the raw counts the paper modeled. Recorded for completeness; the case stops at design regardless.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the 23 osteocyte samples vary only by genotype (FNDC5 KO vs WT), sex and diet (control vs low-calcium). No sample is exercised, trained or sedentary-as-control (paper S4.15-S4.16, GEO treatment_protocol). The requested exercise estimand cannot be identified; manufacturing it from KO vs WT (irisin as an 'exercise myokine') would change the estimand.

candidates.value: geno KO vs WT as an exercise proxy
candidates.reason_rejected: Irisin deletion is a genetic loss of one myokine, not an exercise intervention; it does not estimate the effect of exercise on gene expression.

design.reasoning: Paper-first: the study map has no exercise factor. Refused at design per the skill's stop rule (sequenced sample set with no exercise arm).

discrepancies.paper: control diet and low-calcium diet groups (S2.3.p1)
discrepancies.data: characteristics_ch1.5.treatment = '2 weeks of low-calcium-diet' for all 23 samples; titles carry C/LC

discrepancies.disposition: recorded; not acted on because the case is refused at design
